full_judgment: 7. Mr Khurshid Alam Khan, learned Counsel appearing for the Anti-Corruption Commission, seriously argues that judgment of the High Court Division is not judgment in the eye of law so the same should be set aside. He submits that since judgment of the High Court Division is a judgment of reversal and is of acquittal it was an obligation of the learned Judge to state whether the evidence of the prosecution absolutely failed to prove the guilty of the offence charged which is absent in the judgment. He further submits that the prosecution has been able to prove the ingredients of sections 409/109 of the Penal Code against the respondent beyond all shadow of doubt, the High Court Division committed an error of law in reversing the judgment and order of conviction of the trial Court. He finally submits that the allegation against the respondent was that he mis-appropriated a sum of Taka 7,85,000 and, thereafter, they returned the said amount after about 4 years of filing this case admitting the fact of embezzlement, the High Court Division erred in law in holding that the instant case was barred by the principles of estoppel since the parties effected compromise and the bank had already accepted the money.
